name: tdd-mod
description: Blocks file writes that break Red-Green-Refactor on coding tasks (port of probity's enforceTdd).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Judge file writes against TDD. Off, the mod does nothing.

judgeModel.title: Judge model
judgeModel.description: Judges each file write the agent makes on a coding task: passes it, or blocks it as a TDD violation. It writes no code; the session's own model does. An alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id.

classifierModel.title: Task classifier model
classifierModel.description: Labels each prompt you type as coding (writes are judged) or other (nothing is blocked). An alias or a full model id.

classifyTasks.title: Only on coding tasks
classifyTasks.description: Label each typed prompt coding or other and judge writes only on coding tasks. Off, every task counts as coding.

fastPath.title: Pass a single new test
fastPath.description: Pass a write that adds exactly one test without a model call. Faster, but a new test no longer checks for a refactor left unmade.

secondOpinion.title: Second opinion
secondOpinion.description: Block a write only when a second model call agrees with the first violation.

extensions.title: Source file extensions
extensions.description: Comma-separated extensions of the files judged.

ignore.title: Ignored paths
ignore.description: Comma-separated globs of paths never judged (** any folders, * any name part).

testPatterns.title: Test patterns
testPatterns.description: Overrides how the fast path recognises a test declaration, per extension: a JSON object from comma-separated extensions to a regex, e.g. {"ts,js": "\\bscenario\\("}. Empty keeps the built-in patterns; an empty regex turns the fast path off for those extensions.
